div.head: V Atr 4.1
div.ab: ⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas—biscopas ⁊ abbudas, munecas ⁊ mynecena, preostas ⁊ nunnan—to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas — biscopas ⁊ habbodas, munucas ⁊ mynecena, preostas ⁊ nunnan — to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
And huruþinga Godes þeowas—biscopas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ minicena, preostas ⁊ nunnan—to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ for eal Cristen folc geornlice þingian.

and most of all the servants of God, bishops and abbots, monks and nuns, priests and women under religious vows, shall submit to their duty, and live according to their rule, and zealously intercede for all Christian people.

und vor allen Dingen sollen Gottesdiener — Bischöfe und Äbte, Mönche und Mönchinnen, Priester und Nonnen — der Rechtspflicht sich unterwerfen und nach [kanonischer] Regel leben und eifrig für alles Christenvolk Fürbitte thun.

and above all let the servants of God — bishops and abbots, monks and nuns [of a rule], priests and nuns — submit to their duty and live according to the [canonical] rule and pray eagerly for all Christian people.
div.note: Liebermann compares Ine 1; I Em 1; IV Eg 1.7.
